Description.DefaultValue: Word documents in the BwB format: 17 document types, BwB styles and building blocks, icons, and a Pre-QA check with one-click fixes.

bt:String.DefaultValue: Open the BwB tab to start a document from 17 BwB types, apply BwB styles and blocks, and run the Pre-QA check before sending.
Start any of 17 BwB document types with the cover, contents, numbered headings, writing prompts and the disclaimer.
Brings the BwB styles into this document and restyles Normal and the headings to the BwB format. Text is not changed.
Opens the BwB Toolkit pane: styles, building blocks, the Pre-QA check and the brand guide.
Candara 11 pt bold italic navy, not numbered.
For front and back matter: Executive summary, Glossary, References, Appendices.
A level 2 heading inside front or back matter.
Candara headings in navy. Headings 1 to 3 number themselves: never type the numbers.
Aptos 10 pt, justified, at least 16 pt line spacing, 8 pt after.
The opening paragraph of a section, slightly larger.
A paragraph with a green rule to draw the eye.
8 pt italic charcoal, under a figure or a box.
Candara italic navy with a lime bar. Left word for word.
The lead paragraph, accent paragraph, source line and pull quote styles.
A sequence or a ranking, in navy numerals.
BwB bullet and number styles. Green squares for body lists; no more than two bullet styles on a page.
Fixes house style with one right answer in the selection: UK spelling, dashes, dates, currency codes, per cent, the company name and spaces.
A takeaway, tip or lesson, with a green bar.
A caveat or an assumption, with a charcoal bar.
Two to four headline numbers on a navy panel.
A navy grid of key facts to open a briefing.
One quotation that carries a point.
A titled box with a row of figures and a source.
Services, workstreams or principles, each with an icon.
Label and value pairs, such as a project summary.
Callouts, notes, key figures, snapshots, pull quotes, case studies, icon grids and details tables, with grey placeholders to type over.
Four columns and four rows with a caption placeholder. More options in the pane.
Applies BwB Standard, repeats the header row, right-aligns figures and styles a total row.
A numbered caption to place below a table.
A numbered caption to place below a figure or chart.
BwB data tables: navy header row repeated on each page, figures right-aligned, caption below.
Score options against criteria in a table. Inserted at the cursor in navy.
Search 1,866 Lucide icons and insert them in the BwB colours and sizes.
A table of contents for Headings 1 and 2, then a page break.
The standard BwB disclaimer on its own page at the end.
Funding statement and disclaimer for EU-funded work.
Start the next part on a new page.
Contents, the BwB disclaimer, the EU acknowledgement and page breaks.
Checks the document against the BwB format, house style and the QA checklist, with one-click fixes.
FOR DISCUSSION in the page header.
NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION in the page header.
Removes the sticker from every header.
A status label in the page header, such as Draft or For discussion. Remove it before the final version.
Refreshes the contents, caption numbers, cross-references and page totals.
BwB colours, type, house style, document furniture and icon rules.
